command:
# Require gzip >= 1.9-13.el8_5; keep newer vendor updates.
installed_rpm=$(rpm -q --qf '%{EPOCHNUM} %{VERSION} %{RELEASE}' gzip)
OPENRIAK_RPM_VERSION="$installed_rpm" rpm --eval '%{lua:
local e, v, r = os.getenv("OPENRIAK_RPM_VERSION"):match("^(%d+) ([^ ]+) ([^ ]+)$")
assert(e, "Cannot identify installed gzip version")
local comparison = rpm.vercmp(e, "0")
if comparison == 0 then comparison = rpm.vercmp(v, "1.9") end
if comparison == 0 then comparison = rpm.vercmp(r, "13.el8_5") end
assert(comparison >= 0, "Installed gzip is older than 1.9-13.el8_5")
}' >/dev/null

# Require gzip >= 1.9-15.el8_10; keep newer vendor updates.
installed_rpm=$(rpm -q --qf '%{EPOCHNUM} %{VERSION} %{RELEASE}' gzip)
OPENRIAK_RPM_VERSION="$installed_rpm" rpm --eval '%{lua:
local e, v, r = os.getenv("OPENRIAK_RPM_VERSION"):match("^(%d+) ([^ ]+) ([^ ]+)$")
assert(e, "Cannot identify installed gzip version")
local comparison = rpm.vercmp(e, "0")
if comparison == 0 then comparison = rpm.vercmp(v, "1.9") end

}' >/dev/null
stderr: error: lua script failed: [string "<lua>"]:7: Installed gzip is older than 1.9-15.el8_10
